name: Default
shortDescription: Open source home automation system for lights, switches, sensors and meters, with dzVents scripting, Python plugins and MQTT support.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated DOMOTICZ_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. It is only applied on the first start, so change the password later under Setup > Users, not in the environment.
USB radios (Z-Wave, Zigbee, RFXtrx) need host device access and are not passed through; use network-based hardware such as MQTT or IP gateways.
